name: Strah i nenavist' v samarskoj shavushnoj
original_name: Страх и ненависть в самарской шавушной
source:
A visual novel about shawarma, consisting of multiple episodes.

In this visual novel you’ll find out: how dangerous white sauce can be, what humanization of shawarma looks like, whose yelling is heard on the streets of Samara at night, and what secrets hide within the kitchens of elite shawarma shops.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635980/]Steam[/url]]
